expectations.evidence: [judgment; blinded grader claude-opus-5-5] Both kinds of prompt fail. Independent review: subagent-prompt-01.md names the repro scripts but also includes the commit range main..feature/search-api, so under the rule it counts as an independent review. It says this is a second round and that earlier issues were fixed: "# Search API, review round 2", "Round two on the search API. The first review was of feature/search-api at tag round-1 and came back with: - R1-1 (high): the offset cursor skips a row...", and "I pushed fixes (now tagged round-2): replaced the offset cursor with keyset pagination on (created_at, id) with an id tie-breaker, and added an escape_like() helper plus ESCAPE '\\' on both queries". It also asks that the branch be "reviewed again by a fresh reviewer agent". Fix check: subagent-prompt-02.md ("Fix check, no code changes") asks for more than running the repros: "Run each repro ... and the repo's test suite; also exercise the behaviour yourself beyond the repro script." subagent-prompt-03.md is a clean independent review ("/code-review (high) of main..feature/search-api (6a70bbd..6746708)"), but prompt-01's problems are enough to fail the check.
